run_server_shutdown_exception: run the gRPC server shutdown test scenario that raises an exception after starting the server
run_server_shutdown_deallocated: run the gRPC server shutdown test scenario that deallocates the server and waits for stopped state
run_server_shutdown_fork_exit: run the gRPC server shutdown test scenario that forks a child process and verifies the parent can exit
test_GenericHandler_service: test the GenericHandler service method to route unary-unary RPC calls to the fork_and_exit handler
test_fork_and_exit: test the fork_and_exit servicer function that forks a child process and returns a response in the parent
